summary_md: **HASHIMOTO Hiroki ([@reposapo](https://x.com/reposapo/status/2116097870797713771))** explains **CORAL** from *Don't Lose the Thread* ([arXiv 2610.40350](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40350v1)): long-horizon agents drift because memory fills up, so CORAL keeps only checkpoints and resets the working context mid-task, cutting tokens 6–7× while keeping accuracy.
